title: checklist: re-point two api clauses to the shape #32935 landed, and fix the read-file CPU-budget step (QA 18.4.0 R2 api slice)
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

Three api-slice clauses failed at ee9ad834. In each, the product behaves as its current contract says and the item's text lags. Each fix is a checklist edit: revise the item, bump its `revision`, add a `history` row, and keep `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` green.

1. **records-forms.field-unique-enforcement · acceptance[0]** (stale spec).
   - 28a15270 (#32935, fixes #32711) changed the duplicate sentence to name the field: `A record with this SKU already exists` / `…a unique constraint on 'SKU' already holds this value. No record was written.`, and the details now carry `field`.
   - Re-point acceptance[0]'s verify, and the matching sentence in `automated.ref`. The item's dogfood pin already asserts the new wording.
2. **api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code · acceptance[2]** (stale spec).
   - The same commit widened the 409 details to `{developerMessage, field, object}`.
   - The clause's "no `field` — … the driver names no single column" must expect `field` = the duplicated column. The `error-sentences-live` pin already does.
3. **ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction · acceptance[3]** (assertion defect).
   - At `OS_MCP_READ_FILE_CPU_BUDGET_MS=1` nothing is read before the budget ends, so the product answers `content:"none"` plus the budget note, by design (`packages/mcp/src/file-content.ts:574`).
   - The step needs a budget that lets at least one page through (≈40 ms measured: `truncated:true`, "after page 2 of 180").
   - The fixture should name `showcase_invoice_line.receipt`; `showcase_invoice` has no file field.

The fourth stale fail of the slice, `api-backend.actions-namespace-address` acceptance[0], is already re-pointed by PR #32965 (merged 2026-11-13 04:21Z), so it is not in this card.
